issue_request: FHIR-7077 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction for BaseResource from the DSTU1 2015May ballot. It asked to change the misspelling "reosurce" to "resource" in the Resource Identity/Business Identifier prose at resource.html section 1.10.3.2.1, and Jira's resolution says to fix it.
initial_application: The typo was introduced in source/resource/resource-notes.xml by git commit 7e64b39566241ef56f1c369ba9f837875a5f8b92, which added the business identifier prose with "reosurce". It was corrected by git commit a68a58b221080006917c4b4c535af0f4b9d96ed5 (#7981 - fix typo), changing "However all copies of the reosurce" to "However all copies of the resource". FHIR-7077 itself has no explicit git commit reference, but its Jira comment says "already fixed."
additional_context: FHIR-7981 is a same-change-family Published/Persuasive BaseResource typo issue for the same misspelling and its Jira comments cite fixed #5335, the same source commit that resolves FHIR-7077. FHIR-7981 is already represented on the combined branch, so it was not republished. The Resource page source is current build-scope normative infrastructure, and Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting discussion.
